summary: Iteration 53: Full testing of Custos Recorrentes (Recurring Costs) master consolidated view feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests passed for GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated endpoints. Frontend: All UI elements verified - page loads with data-testid='custos-recorrentes-page', table shows 5 masters with correct columns, expand/collapse works, edit mode works, refresh button works.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated returns masters array with source field (saved/computed)
Each master has version=2 with all required fields: id, description, day_of_month, category, payment_type, frequency, avg_amount, occurrences, months_seen, detail_transactions
detail_transactions array contains full transaction details for expansion: id, date, description, clean_description, amount, category, payment_type, analysis_id, analysis_filename
POST /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated/refresh correctly recalculates and persists masters
PATCH endpoint allows updating description, category, payment_type, frequency, notes, day_of_month, avg_amount
DELETE endpoint removes master and returns 404 on subsequent access
Frontend table shows correct columns: Descrição do Pagamento, Dia do Mês, Categoria, Tipo de Pagamento, Recorrência, Valor Médio (€)
KPIs correctly calculated: Compromisso Mensal, Projeção Anual, Custos Identificados, Categorias
Category breakdown shows monthly totals per category (Salário, Custo Fixo)
Expand/collapse functionality works with chevron icons and detail_transactions displayed
Edit mode shows form with inputs for all editable fields and save/cancel buttons
seed_data_creation: 5 recurring masters exist from previous bank statement uploads: ORDENADO DIEGO OLIVEIRA (1200€), ORDENADO CARLOS MENDES (950€), SEGURANCA SOCIAL - TSU (512€), EDP UNIVERSAL - ELECTRICIDADE (90.17€), VODAFONE COMUNICACOES (45.99€)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custos Recorrentes master consolidated view fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated (returns masters with detail_transactions), POST /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated/refresh (recalculates), PATCH /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated/{id} (updates), DELETE /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated/{id} (removes). Frontend data-testids: custos-recorrentes-page, masters-table, master-row-{id}, expand-master-{id}, expanded-master-{id}, edit-master-{id}, delete-master-{id}, detail-transaction-{id}-{idx}, refresh-btn. Note: User mentioned wanting to verify EDIFICABELLA, BPI 0510348, GOLD ENERGY examples but these are not present in current test data.
features_tested: GET /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated returns 200 with masters array and source field
Each master has required fields: id, description, day_of_month, category, payment_type, frequency, avg_amount, occurrences, months_seen, detail_transactions
detail_transactions contains: id, date, description, clean_description, amount, category, payment_type, analysis_id, analysis_filename
PATCH /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated/{id} updates master fields and returns updated document
DELETE /api/bank-analysis/recurring-consolidated/{id} removes master and returns {ok: true}
Table shows 6 columns: Descrição do Pagamento, Dia do Mês, Categoria, Tipo de Pagamento, Recorrência, Valor Médio (€)
KPIs display: Compromisso Mensal (2798.16€), Projeção Anual (33577.92€), Custos Identificados (5), Categorias (2)
Category breakdown shows Salário (2150€/mês) and Custo Fixo (648.16€/mês)
Expanded view shows: Contrato/Ref, Recorrência inferida, Faixa de valores, Observações, Lançamentos agrupados
Detail transactions show date, description, payment_type, amount
Edit button opens inline edit form with inputs and selects
Edit form has save (✓) and cancel (✗) buttons
Refresh button triggers POST /recurring-consolidated/refresh and updates table
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - all features working as designed. The new master consolidated view correctly groups recurring transactions by description and/or NIB/IBAN, infers frequency (Mensal/Trimestral/Anual), and provides expandable detail view with all grouped transactions.
